summary: The hosts discuss edge computing as a growing market expected to reach $7B by 2022, focusing on two pure-play companies: Fastly and Cloudflare. They analyze the technical advantages of edge computing, market growth projections, and the competitive landscape against cloud giants like AWS and Azure. They also discuss the retail trading boom and its impact on the market.
key_takeaways: Edge computing market growing at 35%+ annually, expected to reach $7B by 2022
Fastly offers 100x faster server spin-up times at 35 microseconds compared to competition
Both hosts own positions in Fastly
Retail investor trading volume has increased significantly post-COVID
Risk of commoditization exists for edge computing platforms
Hardware companies like Cisco and Arista offer more stable, profitable plays
